tools.name: burstproof_scan
tools.description: Run a BurstProof burst scan against your verified staging target. Requires the account Bearer token. Billing: trial (first single scan), pack credit (cross), or run via REST POST /scans with an x402 X-PAYMENT header.

tools.name: burstproof_get_pack
tools.description: Fetch the evidence pack of one of your scans by scan_id.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "burstproof_scan" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
